exactPairRule.description: Streamed IPAK images are admitted only on exact equality of the T6 pair (GfxImage.hash, GfxImage.streamedParts[0].hash) with the IPAK index key (nameHash, dataHash).

importantCorrection: Earlier map/world texture stages used image-name hash as a primary IPAK lookup and could select a same-name payload whose dataHash did not match the retained streamed-part hash. v8 does not repeat that behavior for static-XModel materials.
proofBoundary: No material-name inference and no same-name IPAK fallback. Static Material records are exact-name located in the pinned FastFile. Streamed images require exact two-hash IPAK identity, CRC29 equality, and exact dimensions. Packed block5/514620 first normals reuse only the already loader-address-proven $identitynormalmap.
